Subject: Redwood Ratebook v3 & discount guidance

Jordan / Procurement team --

Thanks for returning the NDA. Per Seans note, sharing the latest ratebook (attached): Redwood_Ratebook_v3.pdf. Highlights and answers to your baseline questions below.

Summary (high level):
- Document attached: Redwood_Ratebook_v3.pdf (PDF, 6 pages) — includes per-token list price, embedding unit price, and packaging for monthly committed tiers.
- Baseline commit discounts (hosted API):
  * 0-50k tokens/mo: list
  * 50k-500k tokens/mo: 10% off list with 3-month minimum
  * 500k-2M tokens/mo: 18% off list with 6-month minimum and monthly reporting
  * >2M tokens/mo: custom tier (please engage AE)
- One-time onboarding credit: typically offered as a $5k credit for annual commitments > $60k; we can propose a tailored credit for pilots if you include expected ramp and a PO.
- Pricing validity: 30 days from today (2027-04-14).

Version control note: this is ratebook v3.0 (internal change log attached in the PDF footer). We maintain a drive copy (link below) and will record the signed NDA on the opportunity in HubSpot.

Next actions:
1) Confirm if 500k/mo is the expected committed starting point so I can send a draft quote (deal id DS-ACQ-1743).
2) If you want an onboarding credit proposal, share expected 3-month ramp numbers and billing cadence.

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890, https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/ratebook-v3

Attachment: Redwood_Ratebook_v3.pdf (PDF, 6 pages)

Best,
Marissa Cole
